product_name: PD1180-EPR — NEMA 34 Smart Motor-Mounted Stepper Controller with USB-C PD 3.1 EPR

requirements.input: USB-C PD 3.1 EPR 48 V / 5 A contract
requirements.motor_current_note: Default diagnostics; explicit board-bound bench-test requests <=800 mA RMS (~773 mA nominal), 10 rpm, 10 seconds then one-second stop ramp. Select application current from post-assembly measurements.

order_hold_reasons: Record fabricator disposition of the eight retained J1/J10 hole-clearance errors and inspect the critical markings among the 475 cosmetic warnings; engineering review preserves these exact findings.

Use the bounded commissioning profile and measure bus/brake response before selecting full-current duty. Current-bank 6 A simulations reach 54.321 V at nominal delay and 54.745 V at 100 us; the latter fails the allocated 0.5 V reserve below 55 V.
Fit the selected DDV cooler/TIM with supported contact and the selected resistor/cooling/guard; record physical fit and motor-current/thermal measurements.

Allocate the exact BOM for the requested five-board lot using the timestamped stock report. Arrange the missing quantities or review substitutions for rows marked unavailable/insufficient; refresh official quantities before allocation.
Measure rear thread/engagement for fastening and inspect WAGO harness retention, bend/tool clearance and strain relief. Keep U18/C52/C53 DNP; magnet fitting is an optional later extension.

After assembly, program and read back TI EEPROM and RP2040 flash, record cold boot, then follow diagnostic, stationary-power and bounded-motor profiles. Default diagnostic flags remain false; the explicit test profiles collect the subsequent powered evidence.
Measure implemented U41 sensor suspend/discharge and 60 MHz USB-idle behaviour, current and wake timing on assembled hardware; record raw-PD/VMOTOR telemetry and fault response.
prototype_gate_scope: Current native CAD and source/firmware implementation only. The driver/protection gate does not qualify 6 A operation: the 100 us recovery and 5 J stress cases plus all physical gates remain open. Exact USB-hole and cosmetic exceptions are engineering-review only.
